jobs.description:
Are you looking for a new challenge in the logistics sector?Do you enjoy working in a friendly and supportive team and are you willing to work in two shifts with bonuses up to 150%? Then this warehouse position at AS Watson or Kruidvat might be perfect for you! Keep reading!

As an order picker/warehouse employee, you’ll be responsible for collecting orders using a voice-picking system, which can be set in multiple languages, including Dutch, English, and Polish. Together with your team, you’ll make sure all orders are ready on time for stores in the Netherlands and Belgium.

You’ll use your organizational skills to efficiently load products onto pallets. These pallets can include items like toothpaste, shampoo, cleaning supplies, toys, and clothing. Since no two pallets are the same, every day brings new challenges.

At AS Watson, you’ll work in a two-shift schedule and receive attractive bonuses of up to 150% per hour for late shifts. Plus, you’ll be part of a friendly team where collaboration is key.

- You work accurately and take responsibility
- Willing to work in two shifts (06:00 - 14:00 and 14:00 - 22:00)
- Flexible availability, part-time options possible
- Minimum availability on Mondays and Tuesdays, plus two Saturday mornings per month
- Own transportation required, as the location is not easily accessible by public transport

Job description: Emirates Cabin Crew are responsible for delivering the Fly Better onboard experience to passengers across our global network. As a member of our Cabin Crew team, you will be the onboard representative of our brand, delivering our signature award-winning service while maintaining world-class safety standards. In the role, you will ensure the safety and comfort of our passengers, manage onboard service and maintain cabin cleanliness throughout each flight. You will respond to passenger requests, working collaboratively with your fellow colleagues to ensure a smooth flight. You will also uphold the highest of service standards in line with the Emirates Fly Better promise. Candidate profile: To be considered for Emirates Cabin Crew, you’ll need to be: Fluent in written and spoken English (additional languages are an advantage) A natural team player with a personality that shines At least 160cm tall and able to reach 212cm high Able to meet the UAE’s employment visa requirements At least 21 years old And have: At least 1 year of hospitality or customer service experience A minimum of high school (Grade 12) education No visible tattoos while in Emirates Cabin Crew uniform Salary information: Your salary includes a fixed basic pay and variable flying pay, which is calculated using number of hours you fly during the month. Salaries are paid monthly. What the company offers: Emirates offers career progression opportunities as you grow in knowledge, skills and confidence. From providing the best customer experience in Economy Class to leading the whole team as purser, we always strive to provide our staff with development pathways that matches your personal and professional ambitions. All Emirates Cabin Crew enjoy a wealth of personal benefits. Furnished accommodation is provided free of charge, with utilities being paid for by the company. When you’re on duty, you’ll enjoy free company transport between your accommodation and the airport/training college,

Do you enjoy working in a logistics environment and like having a variety of tasks?

Who are you?

- You are flexible and do not mind working in a two-shift schedule.
- You live in the region of Deurne, Helmond, Weert, Venray, or Peel en Maas.
- You speak Dutch or English.

As a warehouse operator in Born, you are responsible for processing, picking, and shipping goods. Your efforts ensure the logistics process runs smoothly.

Your tasks:

- Processing and checking incoming and outgoing goods 📦
- Picking orders using modern systems ✅
- Collaborating with colleagues to meet deadlines 🤝
- Maintaining a clean and safe work environment 🧹

You will work part-time from 4:00 PM to 8:00 PM. During your first weeks, you will receive thorough training to perform your job confidently and enjoyably.

For this position, it is important that you:

- Are available from 4:00 PM to 8:00 PM 🕑
- Are quality-conscious and detail-oriented 🔍
- Have a practical mindset and enjoy working in a team 💪
- Are available for at least 25 hours per week 📅
- Speak English 🗣️
- Experience in logistics is a plus but not required.

Looking for a flexible job where you can stay active?

Join Dragonfly in Waddinxveen and decide for yourself which days you want to work. Perfect as a part-time job alongside your studies or another job. Together with your colleagues, you’ll make sure that packages are processed quickly and carefully, so drivers can hit the road on time.

What will you do?

- Place packages on the conveyor belt.
- Sort shipments into the correct roll containers or delivery vans.
- Check that drivers leave with the correct packages.
- Work together with your team to ensure the logistics process runs smoothly.

Working hours

- Morning shifts starting between 4:00 AM and 7:00 AM.
- Your workday ends around 12:00 PM.
- You can work from Monday to Sunday.
- You decide which days you are available.

What do we offer?

- An attractive hourly wage of €14.99 per hour, depending on your working hours and any applicable allowances.
- Working between 12:00 AM and 6:00 AM? You will receive a night shift allowance, and your hourly wage can increase to €19.49 gross per hour.

What do we expect from you?

- You are available for morning shifts that start between 4:00 AM and 7:00 AM and finish around 12:00 PM. The exact start time may vary depending on the shift.
- You are at least 18 years old.
- You speak Dutch and/or English.
- You work accurately, are motivated, and are not afraid to roll up your sleeves and get to work.
- You live in or near Waddinxveen, Gouda, Zoetermeer, Bleiswijk, or The Hague.
- You have your own means of transportation, as our location has limited access by public transport.

At AS Watson in Oosterhout, we are looking for new colleagues who are ready for a fresh logistics challenge. Are you searching for a varied role in a pleasant and motivating work environment, and are you willing to work in two shifts with allowances up to 150 percent? Then the AS Watson warehouse is the ideal place to continue your logistics career.

As an order picker, you ensure that orders for the Kruidvat stores are prepared accurately and on time. You work with a modern voice‑picking system that guides you through the warehouse. This system is available in three languages: Dutch, English, and Polish. Together with this system and your colleagues, you collect orders for stores in the south of the Netherlands and Belgium.

With your organizational skills, you stack the goods efficiently on the pallets. You can expect a wide range of products, such as soft drinks, toothpaste, toys, toilet paper, and cleaning supplies. Every day is different, and no two pallets are the same.

At AS Watson, you receive attractive allowances up to 150 percent and work within a clear two‑shift system. You will also become part of a friendly and motivated team.

- You take responsibility for your work and perform your tasks with accuracy.
- You are available to work in two shifts (06:00–14:00 and 14:00–22:00).
- You are flexible and can work full‑time or part‑time.
- You are available at least on Mondays, Tuesdays, and two Saturdays per month.
- You have your own means of transportation, such as a bicycle, e‑bike, scooter, or car.

Are you looking to work as an operator in Breda within a clean, structured pharmaceutical production environment? Do you want to work with clear instructions and strict quality standards, producing goods that reach patients worldwide? Are you seeking a job that offers a good salary, training opportunities, and a team where precision is the norm? As an operator, you will perform manual production and packaging tasks, monitor quality, and work in a 3-shift or 5-shift schedule. You can earn up to €3,650 gross per month and further develop your skills in a professional work environment.

Functieomschrijving:
As an operator, you work on manual production and packaging lines within a pharmaceutical environment. You follow clear work instructions, inspect the product, and ensure that every step is carried out neatly and in compliance with regulations. Your duties generally include the following:
• Performing manual production and packaging tasks.
• Monitoring quality during the production process.
• Accurately completing batch records, logbooks, and other GMP documentation.
• Identifying and reporting deviations.
• Supporting discussions between Quality and Production to resolve issues.
• Carrying out start-up, shutdown, and cleaning activities.
• Working safely, accurately, and according to established procedures.
• Maintaining a clean, organized, and controlled workspace.

Functievereisten:
This role is a great fit for someone who takes pride in working neatly and feels comfortable in an environment with clear rules. You don't need to know everything upfront, but accuracy, reliability, and a commitment to quality are essential. Does this sound like you?
• Experience in a production environment.
• Ability to work accurately according to work instructions and procedures.
• An eye for quality, safety, and hygiene.
• Comfortable performing manual production or packaging tasks.
• Reliable work ethic and a collaborative attitude.
• Good command of the English language.

Are you looking for an active job in logistics?
